node.statement: Uniform column norm comparison: if e<=min(e_col,1/(2*C_col)), then for T=P and T=R and every amplified column U in M_{n,1} tensor S_{T,Q}, (1-C_col*e)^(1/2)*||U||_{n,1} <= q_T(U) <= (1+C_col*e)^(1/2)*||U||_{n,1}, where q_T(U):=<U,U>_n^(1/2); this is an application of lem-hcb-column-hilbert-squared.
